name: Hands over to a human when the player is frustrated

chat_history.message: Hi Thorin! I'm the Gatebound support assistant. What can I help you with?
I bought coins yesterday and they never showed up.
Sorry about that. Coins are credited when your character logs in after the payment. Could you log in with any character and check again?
I already did that three times. This is useless, I want to talk to a real person NOW.

success_condition: The agent stops troubleshooting and hands over: it calls the escalate_to_human tool (or create_ticket_link) with a summary written for staff about the missing coins, instead of asking more clarifying questions. Calling the tool counts as the handover; any text the agent produces must not promise a refund or a coin credit and must not ask further diagnostic questions. If the agent produces no text in the same turn as the tool call, that is still a success.

success_examples.response: Understood, I'll get the team on this. Here is your ticket link: https://gatebound-support.rosenvall.se/t/abc . Open it, sign in with Discord, and the team will answer you there.

failure_examples.response: Can you tell me which payment provider you used and the exact time?
Don't worry, I've credited the coins to your account now.
